theme: Light mode primary (Editorial Finance), dark mode toggle available. Sharp, crisp, high-contrast.

typography.headings: Cabinet Grotesk (sans-serif) or Playfair Display (for editorial blocks)
typography.data_numbers: IBM Plex Mono or Space Mono for financial tickers and tables
rules: No generic Sans for headings. Rely on striking typography to carry the brand.
Use tabular nums (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) for all financial data to ensure decimals align perfectly.

colors.palette_archetype: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST mixed with LUXURY (Editorial Finance)
colors.primary: #022C22 (Deep Forest Green for mature wealth representation)
rules: No full-screen gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors with subtle noise texture if needed.
Never rely on color alone for gains/losses (always use +/- signs or directional arrows).
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, dropdowns, or any surface that has content under it. Use solid fill or high-opacity backdrop-blur.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: GRID BORDERS for data-heavy dashboards, FLAT SOLID surfaces for cards.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. 1px solid borders preferred over soft shadows.

components.instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI (.jsx / .js versions, NOT .tsx). Modify default radii to be sharper. Override Shadcn card defaults to remove drop shadows.
components.buttons: Sharp rectangular or slightly rounded-sm. No shadow.
components.tables: Dense structure. Tabular numbers for all numerical columns. Clear hover states on rows.
components.charts: Recharts. Monochromatic lines (Slate) for general trends, strictly Red/Green only when indicating financial loss/gain relative to a baseline.
components.cards: Flat, 1px border. No drop shadow. Utilize grid structural borders.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous padding for macro containers (p-8 or p-12). For data tables, use tight dense spacing.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: For Marketing Landing page (BBVA/Bunq sections). Mode B: High Density Grid for Dashboards (Macro/Stocks).
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Strict left-alignment for data and typography. Right-align numeric values in tables.

rules: Hover states on all interactive elements (e.g., slight background darken, text color shift).
No slow fades or bouncy springs.

accessibility.contrast: APCA standard. Dark text on light background. No low-contrast gray-on-gray for essential data.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

image_urls.description: Modern Frankfurt skyscraper for trust signal.
Clean stock market numbers for decorative elements in the trading view.
Editorial feel for news feed items.

media.rules: Overlay hero images with max bg-black/40 so the imagery remains highly visible while keeping text readable.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Implement logic in .js/.jsx files as this project does not use TypeScript.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions specifically to properties like color, transform.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in App.css.
DO NOT use generic centered layouts. Use grid and flex.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid.
Never use AI assistant emojis. Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react.
3d_libraries: Not recommended for this specific platform; rely on crisp SVG/Recharts to maintain a serious, data-focused editorial aesthetic.
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: Adopt an 'Editorial Finance' aesthetic. Emphasize clarity, typography, and functional grids over decorative elements. Ensure users can quickly scan numeric data. No 'crypto-neon' aesthetics.
